title: Call Method Track passes Nil for optional dictionary arguments in functions when created
body:
### Tested versions

-reproducible in: 4.3.stable, 4.4.stable, 4.4.1.stable

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - Intel(R) Xeon(R) CPU E5-1650 v4 @ 3.60GHz (12 threads)

### Issue description

When having a function with an optional dictionary argument, adding a key to a Call Method track in an AnimationPlayer will pass null by default instead of the dictionary that was used as fallback if no argument was given.

when i have a function like this:
```gdscript
# will show up in track as 'empty_optional_dict(null)' instead of 'empty_optional_dict({})'
func empty_optional_dict(dict: Dictionary = {}) -> void:
	print("passed: ", dict)
```
creating a new key with that function will show up like this:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2f40f2c4-8653-4377-91b9-3a536df09004)

I expected that it would show `empty_optional_dict({})` instead in order to mirror the default value.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a scene and attach a script to it
2. Add a function with an optional dictionary argument
3. Add animation player node alongside a new animation
4. Add a Call Method track
5. Add a insert a new key and select the function with the optional argument
6. You should now see that it tries to pass null by default

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[nil-in-optional-function-demonstration.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20257257/nil-in-optional-function-demonstration.zip)
